title: Dogfooding vs. QA vs. User Research
partialText: Dogfooding, or using your own products internally, helps catch bugs, but it can't replace user research: your team knows too much to represent real users.

title: How to Decide When an AI Tool Is Worth Keeping
partialText: Pressure to adopt AI isn't evidence that a tool helps. The PROVE framework tests one tool against one task and produces a provisional decision you can defend.
